title: Hand-written Intel Xe assembly executed on the GPU through a Zebin splice
method: compile a reference kernel with IGC, keep its zebin metadata, append the IGA-assembled listing, repoint .text.sha256_pow at it, clCreateProgramWithBinary

results_buffer.note: expected: this listing has no result store

first_attempt: faulted with CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES because a gen kernel must end with an end-of-thread send; adding send.ts ... {EOT} fixed it, which is also the evidence that our instructions are what executes
caveat: not a race. The listing ignores base and count, runs 8 lanes and stores nothing; IGC's kernel reads arguments, runs 16 lanes and writes digests. This run proves execution, not speed.
